balls.text: Given caught behind. Seam-up from around the wicket. Slot ball with a sharp angle away. Sundar looked to slap it over extra, got a feather to the keeper
Wide and full again, Buttler reaches out and slaps it to deep cover
Thought that was four as the ball smushed the ground, turns out it lost pace and lobbed to the keeper's left. Yorker wide of off, Sundar looking to drive that behind square
Wide yorker is sliced... for six! Proper knife-work from Sundar, slices the bat vertically to guide the wide full ball fine of deep third
Low full toss is wide and is carved to deep cover
Dragged over wide mid-on. Fielding penalty costing CSK as there was only square leg in the deep on the leg side. Choudhary went wide and full, Buttler opened his stance and swiped across

Goes for the leg-stump yorker. Was there to hit but Buttler, staying back, missed the flick. Ball deflects to square leg. CSK take an lbw review but that almost certainly landed down leg. Yeah, no surprises there

Buttler one-ups the wide-yorker plan once again to get to fifty. He continues to stay back and cover the stumps, Kamboj had to get his length right but overpitched, gets carved through extra cover. Cover fielder leapt but couldn't lay finger on it
Yorker expertly dug out through cover. Ball landed just outside the crease but was angling away outside off, he opened his stance, stood deep in the crease and hit it flat

Big cheers for a direct hit at the non-striker's. Tewatia slid the bat but didn't hurry... and the first replay shows he's inches behind as the bails lit up. Was a yorker on off that was driven along the ground. Gaikwad picked the ball up to his right after running across and threw it on the bounce

Slot ball ends Sudharsan's knock. He looked to slap a full, wide 132ks ball down the ground. Got on one knee and almost seemed to try and go inside out. Bat turned outwards and it went right under long-off's throat. Batter smacks hit bat on the way back, good innings though

Remarkable how Sudharsan elevated that wide yorker from so low. He went back in the crease, leant back and hit it from just in front of the back leg. Bottom hand came off late and it sailed to the right of Sarfaraz, who got carried away by the momentum there
Slower one sits up for an age, Buttler winds up meanwhile and pulls it with the sweetest of sounds. Flat through midwicket. Back of hand from Gurjapneet, offered room
Full just outside off, driven to long-off
Missed yorker has been smoked over deep midwicket. Efficient six as that went just a few feet over the fielder. Knee-high full toss at the stumps, helped across from deep in the crease
Surprise slower short ball. Angling away just outside off, Buttler serves it into the ground with limited power, gets a single to midwicket
Pitched up outside off, angling across from around the wicket. Sudharsan was out of the crease as he sweeps along the ground to midwicket
The plan to Buttler is to go wide. CSK are going yorkers but the line seems to be more important. Buttler scythes the low full toss to deep-backward point
That landed on the grass, luckily for Gurjapneet, it was after the ball passed the crease. Went for the wide yorker, got a full toss bouncing to the keeper. Easy leave for Buttler
Free hit is another yorker. Around sixth stump, Buttler snakes his bat low to try and hit it through point, deflects it to long-off
Yorker outside off, 137ks, drills a drive to long-off. Johnson had gotten out of the over. Had, because the siren goes off as he walks back
Yorker just outside off, 139ks, Buttler moves across and chomps it to long-off
Good yorker from around the wicket. Fourth-stump line, lands just inside the crease. Sudharsan opens his stance a touch and dices it with an open face to deep third
Attempted yorker outside off. Finishes as a low full toss, Buttler staying back in the crease may have played a part in that. Driven to long-off
Goes for another wide yorker, this one's just inside. Buttler moved across a bit and got beaten as he looked to smother it behind point
Wide yorker lands well outside off, Buttler looked to scythe it behind square. Dragged the bat along the ground in the end
Bad ball, smashed. Long-off was in play for a second, went flat over him as he leapt. Was a full ball that landed outside off and angled away

Wide not given, review taken. Yorker landed around the tramline, Sudharsan looked to jam it behind square. Ended up missing the ball and plonking the bat onto the ground. He didn't move across... and the ball was inside the guide-line when it was on the crease. GT burn a review
Slot ball tonked down the ground. Seam-up and just outside off, Sudharsan drove through the line, bat did turn inward a bit but that sailed 76 metres long
Yorkers persisted with. Just over the ground and just inside the off-side line. Buttler reaches out and chunks a drive over cover
Falls over a touch as he slaps it to long-off. Opened his stance a touch and slid the bottom leg upon impact. Was a low full toss wide of off
Wide yorker attempted, line's off. Sudharsan was an inch outside off and the ball well away from the tramline
Slapped over cover. Just enough bounce for Sudharsan to stay back and bring out the flat-bat. Slight back of length if at all but the bounce was even. Cover in place, goes over him
Wide yorker attemped. Finishes as a very low full toss. Buttler reaches out and looks to bunt it through point, under-edges it to the leg side
Drives hard, bat turns inward and ball rolls to the bowler. Good stop in the follow-through. Close to yorker but that was full, just outside off, Sudharsan had to drill that a bit
Misses out on the wide full toss. Angle away saves Mukesh as that was around knee-height. Buttler got across and caressed it from the off-side tramline to sweeper cover
Pitched up outside off, toes a drive to cover

Buttler shrugged his shoulders as the bowler ran in and tonked it for six. Got across to off and lifted the slower one into the pitch. Bottom-hand came off but he cleared the shorter 62-metre boundary over midwicket with ease
Slower short ball outside off, pulled to long-on
Yorker gets under the bat as Sudharsan goes for the walk-across scoop. Batter may have nicked it as he crawled across, ball went on to hit the right pad

Dragged across again! Buttler lining up Noor by showing all his stumps and inviting him into the arc. The 92ks ball is fuller this time, and the batter's right under it. Launches it over wide long-on. 22 off, GT take the timeout
Wide called early, they take a single as ball rolls to short fine leg. Length ball lands on leg and goes with the angle, Sudharsan goes hard with the sweep and loses balance
Length on leg, 94ks, flicked off the back foot towards mid-on. Bowler runs back and stops it
Goes back and flicks it the middle-stump length ball through midwicket
Thumped over wide long-on! Buttler working with the angle in, stood on middle and leg and slugged it from off stump. 98ks stock ball was full enough for the step-hit
Shortish ball wide of off, pulled across to long-on
Noor misses his length and gets pumped. Too full on off, Sudharsan is beside the line as he drives straight of long-off
142ks length ball just off, driven on the rise to cover
Wide and fullish, looks to slap it square, misses
Full and slow just outside off, driven to cover
Angles it fine with a leg glance. Length ball finishes on leg stump, Johnson goes 'no' as Buttler helps it off the top of the pad

Out? Midwicket runs back, great catch from Dube. Took it head-high and fell back into the ground, landed his left elbow first to ensure ball didn't get close to ground. Gill shakes his head and walks back. 140ks fullish ball from around the wicket, Gill looking to use the angle by flicking it with whippy wrists. Got low and swished with good hand speed, got it low off the bat
Full ball follows Sudharsan as he moved to the leg-side wide line. He misses the flick and the ball deflects off the pad to point
Length just outside off, back-foot square drive to deep cover
Length on off, pulled against the spin to deep midwicket
Misses out on a full ball that was too straight. Tried to thwack it across the line with a vertical bat, misses

Goes for the reverse launch and misses. Gill switched his stance and opened up space between his feet to try and go behind square, the 95ks back of length ball finished on top of off and went off the glove to the leg side
Length on leg, 97ks, short-arm flick off the back foot to midwicket. Fielder keeps Sudharsan in check with a throw
Length on leg, 95ks, flicked behind square to bring up Sudharsan's fifth straight IPL fifty. He raises his bat and gives a thumbs up
Might've been back of hand again, 105ks. Back of length outside off, cut to deep point
Wide, should've ben more. Fullish ball landed well outside leg and went further away, Sudharsan looked to slap it behind with one hand off the bat, missed it
Sneaky two towards midwicket. Sudharsan flicked it softy, no one in the ring. Bowler stopped it inside the ring but couldn't stop two. Full and slow on off, 108ks
Bunts it off a length with a vertical bat to cover. Good ball, top-of-off
Shortish ball lands around fifth and goes away, good bounce, beats the pulll
Goes for the wide yorker, gets it a touch shorter and beats the square slash. Tight call for wide goes in the bowler's favour. Back-of-hand slower ball that
Slower one goes on the bounce to the keeper. Fullish ball landed well outside off and went away with the angle, let go
Pulled to deep fine leg. 136js back-of-length ball on leg, Sudharsan stays back and swivels, hurried a touch, gets it along the ground
One-handed slash to deep cover. Sudharsan done for lack of pace on the slow low full toss, he got it there by dancing down. Had lot of room
Chipped into the gap! Short outside off and Gill swipes across the line. A bit of a top edge but there's no one in that backward square leg region in the deep and he picks up another boundary.
Gill is just toying with the bowling now! Backs away to another slower short ball and opens the face to steer it past a diving backward point fielder. Immaculate placement
Pace-off short ball sits up nicely, Gill skips out and brings out his short-arm jab to deep midwicket's right. Brevis is quick to run to his right and put in a dive to save two runs there
Full ball angled across, squeezed to deep cover
Back of length and angled across him, cut to point
Cracking drive! Sai Sudharsan skips down the ground to this full ball around off and creams a drive through cover. The off-side sweeper had no chance
Punches this length ball out to deep cover

Short and wide, and he slashes it behind point. And Gurjapneet's sloppiness costs CSK three runs! He runs to his left from deep third and gets down to stop the ball but the ball goes off the outside half of his right hand and gifts CSK a boundary
On a length outside off, punched out to deep point
Sai Sudharsan gets in on the action! Back of length delivery sits up nicely and Sai Sudharsan swings it away over square leg. Fielder in the deep can only watch it sail over
Full ball sliding down leg, Gill whips it out to deep backward square leg
Length ball angled across him, Sai Sudharsan punches it out to deep point
Back of length delivery fired across him, Gill has a swipe across the line but is beaten on the inside edge. Urvil goes up in appeal but it was an optimistic one from him
Driven out to deep cover
Full outside off and punched to cover
Gill now skips out to a full ball and looks to swing it away. gets an inside edge that dribbles to the keeper's left
Slower ball angled across him, Gill taps it to point
Full outside off, driven to mid-off for a quick run

Hammered deeper into the crowds this time and Gill's raced to a 23-ball fifty! Holds his bat up high. This is tossed up in the slot on middle and Gill is onto it in a flash as he flicks this over midwicket
Googly outside off, but a bit short. Gill slaps it away, but finds the cover fielder
Full outside off, he works it to deep midwicket
Flighted full on leg, flicked to Brevis' right at deep midwicket. Just a single this time
On a length around leg, clipped in front of square, in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg. They manage to get two
Huge hit from Gill! This is tossed up right in the slot and Gill whips this over midwicket. Gill picks up his second six, targeting the shorter side this time
Kamboj looks to follow Gill as he backs away leg side. Gill tucks it out to deep midwicket. GT finish the powerplay on 62 for no loss
On a length down leg, goes off his pads through fine leg
Backs away and skips out of his crease to this length ball, adjusts to the line and length and punches this straight of mid-on
And there we have the first six of the game! In the slot from Kamboj, and at his speeds it's easy pickings for Gill. Waits on it and launches it over cow corner

Length ball angled across, steered to backward point and they look to sneak a single. Direct hit at the striker's end from Matt Short, but it looked like Gill had got in. Replay confirms that Gill was comfortably in.
Sai Sudharsan greets kamboj with a loft down the ground. Skips out to this overpitched delivery and lofts it straight of mid-off
On a length outside off, punched out to deep point when on his toes. Good start from Gurjapneet
Full and angled across him, driven to cover's right for a single
On a length outside off, Sai Sudharsan looks to punch it to cover point's left but the fielder makes a good stop
Full outside off, Sai Sudharsan flicks it to midwicket
Length ball outside off, steered to short third
Full outside off, Sudharsan hits an uppish drive, but it bounces before the cover fielder
And now he hammers a drive past cover!  Another slower ball and he dances down, backs away to make room, and thrashes it to cover's left
Gill dances down and lofts this over point! Full and wide and Gill clears the infield with ease. One-bounce four. Gill looking in great touch here. He picked the slower ball early there.
Full outside leg, clipped square on the leg side
Full outside off, Gill eases a drive to mid-off for a single
Full and slanted across him, Sai Sudharsan opens the face to steer it to deep backward point
Edge goes flying over the slip fielder! Sai Sudharsan stepped out of his crease to this full ball outside off and drives hard at it. Gets a thick outside edge that flies over Matt Short
Short and wide, cut away to deep backward point
Punched to mid-off
Fantastic one-handed stop by Matt Short. On a length outside off, Sai Sudharsan looks to glide it fine of Short at slip but he is quick to put in the dive and save a sure boundary
Crunched away through point! Just a tad short and Sai Sudharsan gets on his toes to cut it away between point and backward point
Full outside off, driven to mid-off
Back of length outside off, taps it towards short third and gets a single
Length ball angled across, Gill tries to punch it off side and gets an inside edge onto his pads that dribbles to the slip fielder
Looks for the inswinging yorker, Gill blocks it back to the bowler on the full
Glorious! This is overpitched around off and Gill, perfectly balanced, hits an elegant straight drive. Spencer falls over trying to stop that but it was timed too well
Full outside off, Sai Sudharsan works it to mid-on's left

Oh, what's happened there? It's a length ball angled across Sai Sudharsan and goes down leg, but then swings in to leave Samson wrong-footed as he moved across to his right to try and stop that. Grazes Samson's little finger on the way, and the CSK keeper is hurt as well
Full on the pads, he chips it behind square and it goes to the fielder in the deep on the bounce
Oh, classy stuff. Back of length ball angled across at 142kph and Gill gets on top of the bounce and punches it in the gap between point and backward point

Good fielding from the CSK skipper, chasing this down from mid-on. Full outside off and Gill takes it on, looking to go leg side. He doesn't get enough of it, but manages to chip it over the gap between midwicket and mid-on. Gaikwad races and puts in the dive to pull the ball back just before it reaches the ropes
On a length around off, 141.5kph, Gill blocks
Nice placement from Gill! Full and swinging into his pads, Gill just glances it fine. The deep backward square fielder is not placed fine enough to cut this out
Short and angled across him, cut gently to point
Full outside off, 141kph, Gill works it to midwicket
Starts with an outswinger outside off, Sai Sudharsan runs it down to deep third

Appeal for caught behind, not given. GT review. Johnson removes his gloves and helmet, looks like this is out. Hard length on middle and off, Johnson showed all three stumps and looked to defend straight... and Hawk-Eye shows he got a thin feather. GT, with a net run rate 0.699, have all but confirmed their spot in the top-two. CSK's campaign is done!

Rushed and Rabada takes the easiest of c&bs! 141ks shortish ball following him as Noor went just down leg, Noor tried to fend it leg side last second, the ball popped up off the splice and went to the off side of the pitch. Stayed there for a while
Goes hard for the cut and misses. Shortish ball just outside off, not enough for room for Noor
Back of length around off, defended off the back foot to backward point
Shortish ball on top of middle, pull beaten and he's hit on the trouser
Darted into a length on leg, looks to flick it off the back foot. Spins in and takes the inside edge to roll through fine leg

Kamboj at point and now Brevis at cover. Googly at 96ks but that was a wide long-hop. There to hit it out of the ground. Brevis' baseball-style swipe got the ball off the top-half and Holder took the dolly. That should be the game done
Very wide and on a fuller side of length, let go
Reverse-pulls the short ball from leg stump to deep point. Good control from Noor
Rashid bamboozles his fellow Afghan team-mate. 95ks legbreak lands on off, touch fuller than length and spins away to beat bat. Noor stuck in the crease as he looks to defend straight
Rashid cuts short Kamboj's party. Lures him with a wide 92ks length ball without flight. Kamboj looks to drag it across with a flat-bat swipe. Toed it right up, loops down to backward point
Yorker coming in to middle and leg, right on the crease it lands. Prasidh smiles after Brevis digs it back out
Pulled with limited timing, deep square leg stops it to his right. 142ks short ball at middle, rose to around stomach-height
Goes for the yorker, gets a shin-high full toss on middle. Flicked to deep square leg
Pitched up on middle and leg, flicked to deep square leg

The frenzy continues! Nowhere in control. Kamboj still as a statue in the crease, upright, as he had pretty much a random swipe in front with a closed bat-face. The length ball went off the inside-half through backward square leg
CSK keep chugging. They have to and the lower order is buying in too. Gaikwad is impressed with the pull that sails over long-on. Shortish ball just outside off, played from well in front of the body

Should be out... Kamboj lucky! Holder runs right from cover, was where straight mid-off would've been as he reached out with his right hand and fell. Couldn't get hands on it. Length ball around off, Kamboj looking to slog across the line
Deep midwicket trips over the rope and the ball sails flat. Might still have cleared him. Was a slot ball on off that was slog swept. Rashid puts his hand out in apology
Another googly, at off stump and is defended leg side of the pitch

Unreal from Gill, takes a Phillips-esque catch and shushes the crowd! He ran back from midwicket, settled for a moment, then leapt like there was an invisible swimming pool behind him. Timed it to perfection as the ball went right into hand. 89ks length ball just outside off, the googly spun away. Dube had a slightly open stance and looked to slap it over cover. Chunked it off the upper half
High six over square leg. It's a touch too straight and Dube launches a flick with a closed face, 96 metres far
Length on middle, flicked off the back foot to long-on
Yorker on middle and leg, 134ks, great ball. Brevis goes back and works it to mid-on's left
Goes short again, this is a touch straighter and is pulled with lesser timing. Deep midwicket stops it to his right. 125ks
Short balls are slot balls for Dube. 138ks but it seemed slow at first sight. Lands halfway down and goes just outside off at waist-height, dragged across with a pull over midwicket. 85-metre hit
135ks yorker on middle angles away as Holder delivered from wide of the crease. Jammed by Dube to cover
Carves it despite not getting much room. Dube's elbows are buckled as he rides the bounce, the short ball rises just over shoulder-height. He uses his height and cuts wide of deep third
Dube has clarity and power to match. Stays in the crease for a length ball around off, stays upright and swings through the line. 98-metre six over long-on
Full around middle and off, Dube eases it towards midwicket and they manage just the single. 19 runs off that over
Full on leg and Brevis works it to deep midwicket.
Now he nails the yorker on off and Dube digs it out to long-on
Arshad continues to be wayward. Fires it full and down the leg side
Length ball strays onto his pads and Dube now nudges this to short fine leg's right to keep the boundaries coming. He's striking at 275 right now!
Now a bouncer outside off that jags in. Dube ducks and it's called wide for height anyway
Now Dube thumps one down the ground! Arshad tries to overcorrect and ends up bowling a slot ball outside off. Dube this time nails the shot as he hammers it over mid-off
Arshad goes short and wide and Shivam Dube punishes the width on offer. Slashes it over backward point

Oh, Gill gets a hand on to it but can't hold on to the catch! Dube miscues this lofted drive down the ground but gets it high enough over mid-off. Gill has to leap to his left and sticks his hand up but can only save the boundary there
Punches this length ball out to cover
Flashes at this length ball angled across him and gets a thick edge past the keeper. The ball runs down to deep third
Smartly played, beating deep third! Short ball angled across and he just ramps it fine on the off side. Deep third wasn't fine enough to stop that
Length ball angled across, Dube hits it to mid-off
Full and angled across him, Dube hits a lofted drive over cover. Clears the infield but will have to settle for two

Direct hit and Gill raises his finger himself! Full outside off and Kartik thrashes a drive to mid-off and takes off for a single. He puts in the dive but Gill is on target at the non-striker's end. And his the edge of his bat is just hovering over the crease when the ball hits the stumps so Kartik Sharma will have to make the long walk back! Gill's great day getting better!
Stunning shot! Arshad goes for a leg stump yorker but ends up bowling a slot ball and Kartik brings out a helicopter-shot over midwicket
Lovely bowling. Beats him on the outside edge here. On a length around leg and it just swerves away a touch as Kartik tries to steer it fine on the off side
Short and angled across, he throws his bat at it but doesn't get a touch. Arshad, meanwhile, skids and slips on his follow-through
Bouncer on leg and Kartik sways out of the way
Low full toss on off and he gets away with it. Driven to mid-off
Oh, he's found the gap there! ON a length outside off and he opens the face to thread the gap between backward point and short third
Another 150kph delivery from Rabada, this time on a length outside off, Kartik stabs it to short third
Back of length delivery, 147.6kph, Brevis looks to fend at it and gloves it to the keeper's left for a single
On a length outside off, Kartik Sharma drops it towards point for a quick run
152kph length ball outside off, steered fine on the off side for a quick run

Another one bites the dust! Rabada removes the dangerous-looking Matt Short! This is a 149kph length ball outside off that just seams in a touch. Short is looking to swing it down the ground and gets it off the inside edge. Second catch of the day for Prasidh, and he won't get too many simpler chances than that
Full and wide and Short goes after it as he looks to drive inside out. Slices it over the point fielder running back
Short pushes at this 140kph length ball outside off. Chops it onto the ground and through to the keeper
Length ball seams in from outside off, Short punches it out to deep point
That's a brave shot to play against a bowler breathing fire! Siraj goes for the yorker outside off and Short goes a long way across the stumps. Scoops it over the keeper and fine on the leg side
Full on the stumps, 154.8kph, blunted back to the bowler
Full outside off, still getting that shape away, Kartik gets closer to the pitch and drives to mid-off
Overpitched on middle and leg at 151kph and Short manages to beat the midwicket fielder with his flick. That's a full over where Rabada has gone at 150kph or more!

Well, that would have hurt! Short is grimacing afterwards but seems to be okay. Length ball jags in and Short misses his flick, and the ball hits him on the thighs and gets lodged high between his legs
152.5kph ball seams in from a length outside off, Short pushes at it and gets an inside edge through backward square leg
Full on off, he clips it towards midwicket for a quick one
Nicely driven! This is overpitched and Kartik leans into the drive, hitting it past Rabada's outstretched left arm and past the mid-off fielder to his right
On a length outside off, steered behind point for a quick run
Pokes at this full ball outside off and the ball ricochets to midwicket off the inside half of the blade
Length ball outside off, chopped to deep backward point and Kartik picks up a couple of runs to get off the mark

This goes high in the air and Siraj does have his third wicket of the day! 143kph length ball seams in from outside off and Urvil goes for that pick-up flick. Doesn't get it off the middle and ends up skying it to deep square leg and Prasidh Krishna ends Urvil's homecoming on a sour note

Crowd erupts as the keeper and slip fielder go up in appeal. As does Siraj! Siraj welcomes Urvil with a bouncer that beats the attempted hook shot. Gill has been convinced to review this This is a scramble-seam bouncer dug into the pitch outside off and angled into Urvil. Replay confirms there was no connection there so GT burn a review

Siraj knocks Gaikwad over! Gaikwad was looking for another one of those pickup shots. Siraj pulls back his length slightly and it jags in from outside off. Gaikwad tried to play the same shot as the last ball but misses the ball completely and the ball crashes into top of off. Away goes Siraj for his Siuuuu-lebration. Gaikwad's intent today would have been a breath of fresh air for CSK fans, but the knock is over too early, from their perspective
And now it's Gaikwad's turn to bring out the pickup shot! Overpitched on the pads and he uses his wrists to dump it over the square leg boundary
Length ball outside off, punched to cover point
Lovely pickup shot! Rabada strays onto his pads with a full delivery and Short whips it over square leg with disdain
Back of length outside off, 149.3kph. Short pulls it to mid-on
Opens the face to steer this length ball to short third
Length ball just outside off, steers it behind point. Siraj at deep third has to make some ground to make the stop
Now Rabada errs in line, firing a length ball down the leg side
Short gets off the mark in style! Overpitched outside off and Short creams it wide of mid-off
Full outside off, driven to mid-off

Not quite what Gaikwad wanted to do, but the result is the same! Length ball outside off and Gaikwad shuffles across for the scoop. Doesn't middle it and it goes over the slip cordon instead of leg side of the keeper but carries all the way nonetheless
Nicely done by Gaikwad! Outswinger outside off is overpitched and Gaikwad latches onto it, lofting it handsomely over mid-off
On a length on the pads, Gaikwad taps it to mid-on
Pitched up outside off, hint of swing away, driven to mid-off

Samson is gone first ball! Siraj strikes with the outswinger! It's full and wide and swinging away. Samson goes chasing after it without any foot movement. Gets a thin edge and that's gobbled up by Buttler!
